headline: Climate-Driven Crop Losses Drive Up Agricultural Insurance Payouts in Türkiye
summary: Data from the Agricultural Insurance Pool shows that extreme weather events linked to climate change have caused rising crop damage and increased insurance payouts in Türkiye.
why: Agricultural insurance claims reflect the direct economic toll of climate volatility on food production and insurance sector liabilities.

impacts.name: Agricultural Insurance
impacts.why: Higher payout volumes increase underwriting costs for agricultural insurers due to climate-related crop failures.
